acceptedEvidence.scope: strategy-aware recovery and zero duplicate effect calls

alternatives: Add a separate PreparedEffectRecoveryRecord referenced by IntegrationCheckpoint.
Treat every crash-after-effect-before-result as permanently needs-reconciliation and require a human-authored recovery artifact downstream.
clarification.consequence: This is a public ChangeIntegration contract correction, so WI-CI-CONTRACTS and checkpoint recovery must be revised and reverified before progression.
clarification.question: How should DevRelay durably represent a proven prepared-only recovery when no RawIntegrationEffectResult exists?
clarification.recommendedDecision: Extend IntegrationCheckpoint.reconciled with a closed exclusive recoveryEvidence alternative containing the exact observedState, observation ArtifactRef, produced-commit authorization ArtifactRef when required, and a disposition of applied | not-applied | unresolved. Require exactly one of rawResult or recoveryEvidence; never synthesize a raw result.

findings.message: After an effect changes the target but the process crashes before raw-result persistence, the candidate returns an in-memory recovered disposition from the prepared checkpoint. The canonical IntegrationCheckpoint reconciled state requires rawResult, so this recovery cannot be durably checkpointed or replayed after another restart without fabricating a raw effect result. Product/contract authority must choose an explicit recovery artifact shape.
